definition: Soft Growing Robotics is a subset of soft robotics concerned with designing and building robots that use robot body expansion to move and interact with the environment.
details: Soft growing robots are built from compliant materials and attempt to mimic how vines, plant shoots, and other organisms reach new locations through growth. While other forms of robots use locomotion to achieve their objectives, soft growing robots elongate their body through addition of new material, or expansion of material. This gives them the ability to travel through constricted areas and form a wide range of useful 3-D formations. Currently there are two main soft growing robot designs: additive manufacturing and tip extension. Some goals of soft growing robotics development are the creation of robots that can explore constricted areas and improve surgical procedures.

explainer.lead: Soft growing robotics designs robots that move by expanding their own bodies rather than by walking or rolling. This lets them reach through constricted spaces and form useful 3-D shapes where rigid robots cannot go.

tiers.eli5: Instead of walking to a place, the robot grows into it, like a vine reaching toward the light.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers build these robots from compliant materials so the body can elongate by adding or expanding material. A common pitfall is control: the body shape changes as it grows, so steering and modelling the resulting formation is harder than driving a fixed-link robot.
tiers.paperLevel: A soft growing robot is a compliant-bodied robot whose locomotion is achieved through expansion of the body, either by adding new material or expanding existing material, rather than by jointed locomotion. Limits: designs are split into two main types, and the approach trades speed and structural rigidity for reach through narrow spaces.

explainer.example: A soft growing robot navigates a narrow, winding gap by extending its tip and adding material behind it, forming a curved 3-D path rather than steering a rigid chassis through the turns.
